challenge.method: Compared all four decoded SPDX texts with the complete project file. Checked the grant, repository path, editorial row and page-specific scope.
challenge.results: Only Linux-man-pages-1-para matched. Its verbatim-header requirement and author-and-date condition for nontrivial modification distinguish it from all three copyleft forms. The path identifies the stored form and supplies no historical page revision.

limitations: The project file identifies a notice form. Applicability to an individual historical manual page requires evidence specific to that page.
The lifecycle decision is conditional on qualification. This review establishes no release qualification or project-wide licensing determination.
